alive.last_commit_message:
fix(llm): refuse a known provider with no base URL instead of a guessed host (#910)

With no saved profile and XALGORIX_API_BASE unset, the client fallback
(CLI/TUI scans, web scans without a fixed endpoint) and the legacy resolver
sent a request to the generic default host whenever the routing provider
had no default base URL, carrying a known provider's key to a host it does
not belong to. The composite resolver already refused these configurations.

defaultBaseWithoutAPIBase now returns a ConfigError naming
XALGORIX_API_BASE for a known provider without a usable default base. A
bare model with no provider, an unknown provider name, and a selected
same-vendor provider keep the generic default.
